About PDF Tools

PDF Tools is an independent document toolkit built around local browser processing. It helps with everyday PDF organization, image conversion and basic editing.

The available operations have different limits. Word conversions are basic text conversions; image-based compression changes document features. Read each tool’s guidance and review outputs. There is no affiliation with iLovePDF or other PDF services.
